steps.title: Welcome to CatRealm
steps.body: A quick look at where everything lives. You can skip it any time.

steps.title: Home
steps.body: Your friends, friend requests and recent chats.

steps.title: Servers
steps.body: Your realms. Double-tap to open the server list from anywhere.

steps.title: Discover servers
steps.body: Browse public servers here and join any that look fun.

steps.title: Chats
steps.body: Your direct messages and group chats.

steps.title: Notifications
steps.body: Mentions, replies and requests, all in one place.

steps.title: Open your profile
steps.body: Tap You to continue.

steps.title: Edit your profile
steps.body: Tap the pencil to set a profile picture and banner.

steps.title: Add a profile picture
steps.body: Tap your avatar to upload one.

steps.title: Add a banner
steps.body: Tap the banner to upload one.

steps.title: Server Profiles
steps.body: Use a different picture or banner on specific servers. Your main profile is the fallback.

steps.title: Account Security
steps.body: Your signed-in devices, passkeys and security keys.

steps.title: Voice & Video
steps.body: Microphone, speakers, and voice activity or push to talk.

steps.title: Notifications
steps.body: Push notifications, and the sounds for messages, calls and voice.

steps.title: Appearance
steps.body: Themes and how heavy the animations are.

steps.title: Emotes & Settings
steps.body: How large emotes appear, plus your personal emotes.

steps.title: Content & Social
steps.body: NSFW filters and the link domains you trust.

steps.title: Cat Cache
steps.body: How much space images, videos and emotes may use on this phone.

steps.title: Language
steps.body: The language CatRealm uses on this device.

steps.title: Cat Lab
steps.body: Experimental features. Fun, but use them at your own risk.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.body: You can replay this tour from the You tab whenever you like. Have fun!
